nirf_name: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology
description: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology is a non-affiliating teaching and research university established in 2013 by the Government of Uttar Pradesh after reconstituting Madan Mohan Malaviya Engineering College, Gorakhpur. Its 354-acre campus is located on Gorakhpur-Deoria Road in Gorakhpur.

agent_notes: Normal TLS verification first returned the managed proxy's exact self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the confirmed search hosts and official mmmut.ac.in host.
The official homepage and Location & Campus page confirm the Gorakhpur campus and city; district is recorded as Gorakhpur.

The central Programmes page is internally inconsistent and incomplete: it conflicts with the current UG BBA duration and does not reflect the current 2026-27 PG poster's M.Pharm and updated M.Tech offerings. The current official 2026-27 PG notification linked from the official PG admissions page was therefore used for current PG programme names.
No standalone diploma or certificate programme was listed in the official central programme catalogue; short-term training and certificate notices were excluded as news or events.

The official career tree has no dedicated nodes for several postgraduate or doctoral credentials, so nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings with medium confidence were used where necessary.
